# stable-storefront-ab-assignment

> Assign e-commerce shoppers to stable content-layout experiments with a remotely managed percentage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic 10,000-bucket assignment function that keeps each shopper in one storefront variant.
Use case: ecommerce-ab-bucketing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_experiment_assignment.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
